caption: The drawing is in black ink on a beige or off-white background and depicts three technical views of a chair: top elevation, side elevation, and front elevation. The top elevation view shows the rectangular seat of the chair shaded with diagonal and solid fills, framed by straight lines, and annotated as "A" and "D." The seat is indicated with cross-hatching and solid gray shading. The side elevation displays the chair’s profile, featuring a straight back with five curved horizontal slats labeled "B," slightly angled back legs, and an armrest on the left side connecting the back and front legs. The seat area is filled and labeled "D." The front elevation shows the chair facing forward, with vertical legs, five undulating horizontal back slats labeled "B," a rectangular seat with cross-hatching, and horizontal elements labeled "D" at the lower sections. Additional annotations specify dimensions such as heights and widths, and a legend explains the labeling conventions. The composition arranges the three views in a grid and includes both dashed and solid construction lines with accompanying measurement indicators.
title: Chair
